FIELDS.NAME: Hobby Haven
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: No contact available for inspection due to non-compliance with hazardous material regulations.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Hobby Haven operates as a retail establishment specializing in hobby and model-building supplies. Our core operations focus on providing a diverse range of products, including model kits, craft supplies, and hobby tools, while ensuring compliance with all local safety and fire regulations. We emphasize a well-maintained shopping environment with organized displays and clear aisles to enhance customer safety and overall experience. Additionally, we conduct regular inventory audits to ensure product availability and minimize loss. Our knowledgeable staff is trained to offer expert guidance and safe usage advice, fostering a supportive community for hobby enthusiasts. We also host instructional workshops that are covered with appropriate professional liability insurance, making sure that any activities are safe and teach proper techniques. To uphold our commitment to safety, we do not engage in sales or rentals of hazardous materials exceeding minimal regulatory quantities, ensuring a safe environment for our customers and staff alike.

Our hobby shop offers a wide range of model-making supplies, including specialty paints and adhesives that may contain small quantities of hazardous materials for enthusiasts engaged in detailed projects.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: No losses to report as we have not engaged in any activities involving hazardous materials or experienced any claims related to customer or employee injuries.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class II Safe, Grade 2, Commercial Label
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Secured premises with video surveillance and regular inspections by qualified staff.
